statement.text: Let $h(n)$ be such that every graph on $n$ vertices with $>n^2/4$ many edges contains a triangle whose vertices have degrees summing to at least $h(n)$. Estimate $h(n)$. In particular, is it true that $ h(n)\geq (2(\sqrt{3}-1)-o(1))n? $
